thread:
ash: quick rollcall for tomorrow's RFC review (10:00am PT). authors are @elaine and @morgan. Can reviewers confirm availability? please drop pre-read links by EOD today.

elaine: I can do it. pushed the draft to the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/486 — section on fallback policies is still rough.

morgan: slides uploaded here: https://drive.internal/s/1a2b3c — TL;DR: proposal adds routing policy + canary config. will add a short checklist before EOD.

sam: heads-up I'm on call 9:30-10:15, so I can join the first ~15 mins then need to drop. if you want me to review the canary logic beforehand ping me.

rajesh: I can review. prefer we schedule author Qs near the end so reviewers can flag infra concerns first.

ash: good call @rajesh — proposed agenda (very short):
```
1) 10:00 - 10:05 - quick intro + goals
2) 10:05 - 10:25 - author walkthrough (elaine, morgan)
3) 10:25 - 10:35 - reviewer feedback / infra concerns
4) 10:35 - 10:40 - decisions & action items
```

ash: also, tagging @scheduler-bot to send reminder 2h before. can authors add 3-5 short pre-read questions to guide reviewers? :point_up:

scheduler-bot: reminder scheduled for 2 hours before meeting. :robot_face:

elaine: will add 4 quick pre-read Qs to the PR description (performance, fallback ordering, rollout config, telemetry) by 5pm PT.

morgan: added the checklist and one sample curl for local testing: `curl -X POST https://local.test/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

sam: added a comment on the telemetry question in the PR.

ash: perfect. if anyone else can't make it, drop your notes in the PR and we'll capture them in action items. :thumbsup:

rajesh: sending two infra notes in a thread on the PR now.

ash: thanks all — see you tomorrow.
